items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: Orish Kriotramon came out good first time.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, yeah. I don't know. When you came for the record station? Yeah, regular clothes. Just street clothes. Did you make more than one... What? ...take on each two, or you just played one?
Oh, some of them came out... All right. Orish Kriotramon came out good first time. First time, right? But those... You know, the vocals, you know, wait to go with them again.
